name: NYC REACH Members
description:
This dataset lists members of NYC REACH, a health-focused program, with one row per provider or practice site. Each record includes the provider's first and last name, practice or site name, primary specialty, organization type (such as small practice, pharmacy, community-based organization, or urgent care), and the practice's mailing address, borough, and ZIP code. The sample covers 2,376 rows across all five New York City boroughs, with Queens, Brooklyn, and Manhattan most represented. Primary specialty is missing for about 31% of records, while other fields are nearly complete.

The data can be used to map the geographic distribution of participating providers and organization types across boroughs, identify specialty coverage and gaps, support outreach or recruitment planning, and analyze access to care by neighborhood or ZIP code. It is also useful for joining with other health or geographic datasets to study provider networks in New York City.
